plugins.label: Web search
plugins.description: Lets the agent search the public web. Backed by a managed search API (PerkOS pays).
examples: Search the news for the latest Base chain governance proposal.

plugins.label: Code runner
plugins.description: Sandboxed Python / Node execution. Runs in an ephemeral container per call; no persistent fs.
examples: Run this Python snippet and tell me the output.

plugins.label: Vector memory
plugins.description: Long-term recall via pgvector. Agent embeds and retrieves past notes / docs.
examples: Remember that I prefer concise replies.
What did we discuss last week about the launch?

plugins.label: GitHub integration
plugins.description: Read PRs, issues, reviews. Write comments + reviews when allowed.
examples: Summarize the open PRs on PerkOS-xyz/PerkOS.

plugins.label: Notion sync
plugins.description: Read and write to Notion workspaces. Per-database access scopes.
examples: Drop today's standup notes into the Engineering page.

plugins.label: Calendar
plugins.description: Schedule and inspect calendar events. Google + Apple supported.

plugins.label: Google Drive
plugins.description: Search, read, and update Drive files.
examples: Update the roadmap doc with Q3 milestones.

plugins.label: Headless browser
plugins.description: Navigate sites and capture content. Useful for sites without an API.
examples: Pull the pricing table from competitor.com.
